SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-06: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.forEach, ViewDefinition.select.forEachOrNull. Test these items: forEach 0..1 FHIRPath expression selects parent elements for the containing select, forEach multiplies rows for each item in the selected collection, forEach suppresses rows when the collection is empty, forEachOrNull preserves one row with null nested values when the collection is empty, nested columns are evaluated relative to each iterated item, built-in ViewDefinition/FHIRPath variables remain correct in iterated contexts, including %context, %resource, %rootResource, and %rowIndex. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.select.forEach / forEachOrNull definitions: each is 0..1 string; FHIR JSON present primitive null is not absence. Functional model says forEach unnests selected collection rows and forEachOrNull preserves one empty record when the collection is empty.
issues.evidence: Fresh .temp/qa/sof_vd06_skeptic_probe.py failed before remediation: present-null forEach was accepted. Direct repro: parse_view_definition({"resource":"Patient","select":[{"forEach":null,"column":[{"path":"$this","name":"value"}]}]}) returned a ViewDefinition and SQLGenerator generated SQL instead of raising ParseError. The same applies to forEachOrNull:null.
issues.root_cause: The parser used select_data.get("forEach") and select_data.get("forEachOrNull"), making present JSON null indistinguishable from an absent optional field.
issues.resolution: Added parser-side optional FHIRPath primitive parsing that checks key presence and rejects present null before calling the shared dataclass helper; added parser regression coverage for null forEach/forEachOrNull.
